observations: Two isolated native SQLite desks used the actual reference issuer over HTTPS with a temporary trusted certificate.
Native custody approved two pairings and one encrypted snapshot with independently returned issuer credentials.
Private synthetic content was absent from the exported encrypted envelope.
A change to the receiver authority refused the exact file with its prior state intact.
The approved transfer survived native desk reopen and duplicate delivery left the stored state unchanged.
scope: Local file transfer between isolated desks on one Mac with synthetic Castalia custody.
